in_hebrew.name: בת־יואת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name 'Evette' is derived from the Hebrew words 'evet' (daughter) and 'yahweh' (God). It is a beautiful name that means 'daughter of Yahweh', emphasizing the strong bond between the child and their Creator.

in_greek.name: Εὐαίτη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Evette' is derived from the Greek word 'εὔ' (eu) meaning 'good, gracious'. This name is a reflection of the kindness and generosity of the one bearing it.
